basic_info.description: Just over a block from vibrant Cortland Ave, this handsome, renovated 2 bedroom + den, 2 bathroom Midcentury single family home offers meticulous design and modern comforts. The open concept kitchen with quartz waterfall edge, 5 burner gas stove, floating wall shelves and a large skylight opens directly to an Ipe wood deck, perfect for BBQ's and outdoor dining, with stairs leading to a beautifully landscaped yard. Based on designs from Protea Landscape Architects, the terraced garden is a serene retreat with manzanita, succulents, blue sage, verbena, reed grass, and maple tree, all complemented by a decomposed granite path leveled for optimal drainage. The living and dining area blends seamlessly with the kitchen and features a vaulted ceiling with multiple windows creating a bright and airy space. A 2016-17 renovation materially improved the home with a down-to-the-studs kitchen and primary bathroom remodel, guest bathroom refresh, new deck, new sliding door, new tile entry, and a fully re-skimmed main floor for a smooth, modern finish. More recently, the home received a new roof, new interior/exterior paint, and refreshed front/rear gardens. Completing the home is a pristine garage with a newly epoxied floor, two-car parking, and ample storage!
